tenderSchedule.title: CV/TN-263/Providing Consultancy Services for Third Party Quality Supervision of Infrastructure works at various campuses of University of Horticultural Sciences, Bagalkot.
tenderSchedule.description: Providing Consultancy Services for Third Party Quality Supervision of Infrastructure works at various campuses of University of Horticultural Sciences, Bagalkot.

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Office of the Estate Office Udyanagiri, Near Simikeri Cross Bagalkot - 587104

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Receipt of Tender is through e-Procurement portal only.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The proposal should be submitted by a firm individually. No Consortium/Joint Ventures are allowed.

Tender Documents may be downloaded from Government of Karnataka e-Procurement website https://kppp.karnataka.gov.in through contractors login. Aspiring agencies who have not registered in e-procurement should register before participating through the website https://kppp.karnataka.gov.in
If agencies have quoted same service charge, then bidder will be selected as per their maximum average turnover for the last Five years of the bidder.

Agencies can access tender documents on the website, fill them and submit the completed tender documents into electronic tender on the website https://kppp.karnataka.gov.in after submitting the tender processing fee in the form of e-payment.
The rate to be quoted shall include conveyance of staff, salaries, transportation of lab equipment (if any), taxes (Excluding GST tax) and any other incidential charges.

List of campuses, Main Campus UHS, Bagalkot, KRCCH, Arabhavi, COH, Munirabad, COH, Bangalore, COH, Sirsi, COH, Kolar, COH, Mysore, CHEFT, Devihosur (Haveri) and Any other campus in university jurisdiction.

The consultants have to render the service till completion of the said project, even after expiry of the term mentioned & the payment will be made as per the earlier percentage quoted during agreement.

Agencies should attach all the Scanned and attested copies by gazetted officer of the Original certificates pertaining to their eligibility criteria, qualification information documents, EMD through e-payment only. No physical documents shall be considered.
Any effort by the Agency to influence in the bid evaluation, bid comparison or contract award decision, results in rejection of the consultants bid.
The bidders are informed to visit e-procurement portal for KC-8 manual and are abide to conditions laid in the manual

A successful tenderer will have to execute an agreement for the related schedules of a project awarded to the successful tenderer/agency/bidder as per standard document for procurement of work with the Estate Officer, University of Horticultural Sciences, Bagalkot within 7 days upon receipt of intimation, failing which his tender will be rejected and EMD will be forfeited.

The interested Consultants need to register with the e-Procurement portal for participating in the tender. The Consultants are requested to get updated with corrigendum/addendum (if any) issued online at the following e-Procurement website in the entire tender process. https://kppp.karnataka.gov.in

The date of negotiations will be intimated soon after the opening of financial bid. If needed the University reserves the right at its absolute discretion to proceed or cancel with the tender at any stage before awarding the work.

The work shall be commenced with all earnestness within 7 days from the date of issue of work order, failing which it would be presumed that he is not interested in the work and action will be taken to get the work executed through alternate agency.
Corrigendum/modifications/correction, if any, will be published in the website only.
Further details of work can be obtained at the office of the Estate Officer, University of Horticultural Sciences, Udyanagiri, Near Simikeri By pass, Bagalkot.
Duties and Taxes: All duties, taxes and other levies at the rates as on the date of submission of tender shall be payable by the Bidders (except GST or any other tax which shall be paid extra).

Validity: The proposal shall be kept valid for a period of 120 days from the stipulated last date for receipt of proposals as mentioned hereafter. The overall offer including key personnel proposed for the assignment and your quoted prices shall remain unchanged during the period of validity.

Evaluation of Offers: Proposals received and found responsive will be evaluated by Technical bid evaluation Committee of the University. The Bidders should take enough care to submit all the information sought in this document in the desired formats. The Proposals are liable to be rejected if information is not provided in the desired formats. The proposals, in general, shall be valuated on the following basis: (a) Technical Proposal: The technical strength of the consultant is evaluated after combining the marks scored as per the Evaluation Criteria. The minimum qualifying score would be 75 points.

Evaluation of Offers: Proposals received and found responsive will be evaluated by Technical bid evaluation Committee of the University. The Bidders should take enough care to submit all the information sought in this document in the desired formats. The Proposals are liable to be rejected if information is not provided in the desired formats. The proposals, in general, shall be evaluated on the following basis: B) Financial Proposal: The Bidders who secure more than or equal to 75% marks in the technical proposal shall only qualify for consideration of opening of financial proposal. Financial Proposals of all qualifying Bidders will be opened. The score on price quote will be calculated in the following manner: Proposal evaluation: 100 x X / Y Where X- Price of lowest responsive Bidders Y - Price of any other Bidder The percentage marks allocated to the lowest responsive Bidders will be 100 and to any other Bidder, 100 x X / Y. The Bidders will quote their fees in percentage of project cost inclusive of all prevailing taxes inclusive of service tax and will include interalia, the fee for all components identified in the Terms of Reference. The Price Proposals is to be provided in the formats shown in Appendix-2. Lack of clarity on cost of any item as called for above could lead to the Proposals being rejected, if it hinders a uniform evaluation process, even if the Proposals meets all other requirement of technical criteria.

The earnest money deposit may be forfeited (a) if the Tenderer withdraws the Tender after tender opening during the period of tender validity. (b) If the Tenderer does not accept the correction of the Tender Price, pursuant to Clause 21, or (c) In the case of a successful Tenderer, if the Tenderer fails within the specified time limit to (i) Sign the Agreement, or (ii) Furnish the required Security deposit

Conditional Bids will not be accepted and University reserves the rights to modify /split the work to more than one applicant and accept or reject any or all the proposals at its sole discretion of any stage before issuing the Notice to Proceed with the work.
The QSC shall provide suitable transport to its Engineers to be able to visit the sites periodically at their own cost.
The Quality Supervision Consultants (QSC) should be located in India and should have office in Karnataka. The QSC must be familiar with local conditions.
Quality Supervision Consultants shall carryout inspections as mentioned in the T.O.R for each work during execution of work for guiding the departmental Engineers and Contractors and quality of work.

The successful bidder shall deposit a sum of Rs. 1,00,000.00 (Rs. 1.00 lakh)In the form of DD / FDR drawn in favor of Comptroller, UHS, Bagalkot of scheduled / nationalized bank as a security deposit, repayable after the successful completion of stipulated period of the bid (i.e. 3 years from the date of issue of Proceed with the work).
Tenderer shall abide by the conditions under KC-8 of Karnataka Service Manual for this tender have to visit e-procurement portal for KC-8 Manual.
All the tenderers shall get updated with corrigendum / addendum issued from time to time during the entire tender process (https://kppp.karnataka.gov.in).

The rate shall be quoted in terms of percentage of project cost for the works (Campus wise) across the jurisdiction of the University. The percentage so quoted shall be inclusive of conveyance of technical and other staff/samples, laboratory testing of materials, on site testing of work etc for new and upcoming works costing more than Rs. 200.00 lakhs each in individual campus
